text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia to boost purchases of Iraqi crude oil.
- Uday Saddam Hussein receives Qatari official at hospital in Baghdad.
- (Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin) Erbakan says Turkish exports to Iraq to increase in the near furture.
- Iraq television shows spies who worked for the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency.
- Celebrations continue to mark safety of Uday Saddam Hussein.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Police capture gang of car thieves.
- Hundreds of Turkish trucks laden with foodstuffs travel to Iraqi every day.
